description: Standing re-measure list for wave land. Mode-3 green alone is not wave exit. Near-void stills fail closed.

mode_1.measure: shots/<label>/capture.json source includes browser-threejs; black_frame=false; pass_hard_gates=true
Aligned to measure black_frame: mean luma >= 38, unique samples >= 48, near_black_frac < 0.82, dims >= 64x64; black_frame must be false (mean≈27 / unique≈11 near-void fails)
mode_1.cmd: node tools/capture.mjs --label wave2 && node -e "const c=require('./shots/wave2/capture.json'); if(c.black_frame||!c.pass_hard_gates) process.exit(1)"

mode_1.measure: No Wooloo/TW plates under shots/wave* or shots/_sheets; contactsheet refuses minimal-capture and black_frame
docs/VISUAL-BAR.md sky/grade + soft light checklist vs TW presentation (not claim of mode-7 win)

mode_3.measure: npm run test:playtest green — starter, grass, battle, catch, heal, no official name leak

mode_4.measure: p99 frame time ≤16.7ms @1080p medium during battle VFX; zero frames >50ms after warm-up (tools/profile.mjs when present)
mode_4.note: Mode 4 unmeasured until profile script lands; do not claim F pass without ring data.

mode_5.measure: Input→menu ≤400ms; move→first attack frame ≤180ms; HP tween + AV feedback timestamps
mode_5.note: Mode 5 instrumented latencies required for ultracode wave exit; playtest green alone insufficient.

mode_7.measure: Labels-hidden forced choice: prefer our still over Twilight Wings reference
mode_7.note: Mode 7 double-blind must prefer US over TW or keep looping. Mode-3 green is NOT wave exit.

mode_7_note: Blind A/B must prefer US over Twilight Wings reference; playtest green is not sufficient.
land_cmd: npm run typecheck && npm run test:battle && npm run test:playtest && npm run build && node tools/capture.mjs --label wave2
